pages.text: The world finally has a calendar, and Danger's farm signed up on day one. OreSpawn crops now ripen with the seasons instead of the clock: plant with the calendar and the field cooperates; plant against it and the crop simply waits, unbothered, for you to notice.$(p)No withering, no penalties. The season forgives — it just doesn't negotiate.

pages.title: The Crop Calendar
pages.text: Cut this out and nail it to the barn.

pages.title: Planting by Season
pages.text: $(li)Spring — radishes and lettuce.$(li)Summer — corn, tomatoes, and strawberries.$(li)Autumn — quinoa and rice.$(li)All year — the experience, moth, firefly, butterfly, and mosquito plants, which are magic and decline to acknowledge weather.$(p)Out of season a crop pauses its growth entirely, so stagger your fields and something is always coming in.

pages.title: Climate Zones
pages.text: The pack's dimensions are climate-zoned on purpose. The $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/mining_dimension)Mining Dimension$() and the Chaos dimension don't do seasons at all, while $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/beyond_the_tunnels)Utopia$() files as tropical — an eternal growing season on the King's own lawn.$(p)The overworld carries the full four-season cycle, exactly as the calendar item reports it.

pages.title: The Seasons Celebrate
pages.text: Boss celebrations now read the sky before loading the fireworks: victory volleys launch in the current season's colors — blossom pink and fresh green in spring, gold and clear-sky blue in summer, harvest orange and maple red in autumn, snow white and ice blue in winter.$(p)The celebrations themselves are covered in $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/a_reactive_world)A Reactive World$().

pages.title: Season of the King
pages.text: When a full season turns — a real turn, not a sub-season shuffle — the Prince takes wing over the overworld to announce it, gliding across the sky near one lucky witness. Being that witness grants the $(thing)Season of the King$() advancement.$(p)If Serene Seasons ever leaves the pack, all of this quietly falls back to the real-world holiday calendar. Nothing breaks. House rules.
